title: Fuel Tank and Lines — 3.7L Duratec (227kW/301PS)
introduction:
The tank’s level sender reports quantity; it cannot certify delivery pressure or injector operation. I think of the gauge as a restaurant’s stock count: ingredients on the shelf do not prove dinner reached the table. The pump supplies fuel, the rail distributes it and the injectors meter it, so those jobs need to stay distinct when considering a complaint.

This page sends fuel tank and line diagnosis to the applicable Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis manual. That manual is not included here; diagnostic preparation, equipment, measurements and result-dependent next steps must come from that reference. This page is a starting point for finding the diagnosis, not a standalone test.

items.name: Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual
items.detail: Obtain the diagnostic information applicable to the engine identified in this page’s title before choosing equipment or attempting a fuel-system test.

edits.text: For fuel tank and line diagnosis, refer to the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual and select the information applicable to this engine.
edits.why: A fuel-level reading cannot establish whether delivery pressure or injector operation meets the required test. The engine-matched diagnostic reference is needed to make that assessment.
